result.rationale: Adult with mild lateral ankle sprain features: no malleolar or midfoot bony tenderness, able to take four steps both immediately and now, no deformity, numbness, wound, or skin color change. Ottawa criteria not met by self-report; NHS guidance supports home care (protection, rest, ice, compression, elevation, gradual movement) with instructions to seek assessment if pain/swelling worsen, weight-bearing becomes impossible, or no improvement.
